subject: A very DIY Spanish domestic garage used by a young indie band, SEEN FROM THE OPEN GARAGE ENTRANCE looking INTO its depth toward a cluttered BACK WALL OF SHELVES. The camera is at the doorway; the garage door is above/behind the viewer, never on the rear wall. A lived-in, improvised, affectionate mess, not a clean fitted garage or professional studio. The back has mismatched reclaimed-timber and metal shelving full of battered cardboard boxes, paint tins, jars, hardware, scrap timber, folded old fabric and coiled extension leads hanging off wall hooks. An improvised workbench from a rough plank and mismatched supports, a crooked tool board, a half-hidden old wheel and a rolled mat stand at the rear and edges. Patches of exposed brick, uneven plaster and reused wood panels; visible ceiling tracks and beams near the entrance. A small blanket or reused fabric is clipped to one back-wall patch as homemade sound treatment. Rich recognizable domestic storage clutter with large readable shapes, no labels.
